body:
Maya: Quick idea — for the Quickstart Kits launch let's localize three languages first: en, es, ja. Keep code identical, translate only prose and screenshots.
Jeremy: Agree. If snippets stay the same we can keep bench comparability across locales.
Maya: Plan: 1) extract all user-facing text into spreadsheet 2) vendor translate 3) devrel review PRs 4) publish region-specific landing pages. Timeline: 2 weeks for initial set.
Samir: How do we route inbound leads from localized pages? Need UTM + regional SDR assignments.
Olivia: We can add a hidden field region=EU/LA/APAC and use HubSpot workflows to assign leads. @Ben can you confirm?
Ben: Yep — HubSpot can route by geo + UTM. I'll create workflows and test webhooks. Also recommend tagging benchmark rows per locale on the pages so folks know expected latency/cost per region.
Maya: For benchmark narratives: keep one canonical benchmark, plus a per-region note about latency expectations and recommended model variants. Example snippet to show on page: `Latency (p95): ~120ms (us-west), ~210ms (eu-west)`
Jeremy: Webinar hook idea: "Build localized AI features with Redwood Quickstart Kits" — 30 min demo + 15 Q&A. Speakers: Maya, Alex_devrel, Samir. Proposed date: Mar 12.
Olivia: :thumbsup: I'll draft the event page. Marketing wants two CTAs per page: "Try Quickstart" and "Request enterprise demo".
Maya: Required assets: translation spreadsheet, screenshot pack per locale, localized code examples, benchmark table. I'll drop initial versions in Drive: https://drive.redwood.example/quickstart-localization
Ben: Add small auto-UTM script to embed on landing pages: `?utm_source=quickstart&utm_campaign=localized_launch&utm_region={{region}}`
Alex_devrel: I'll own the tutorial walkthroughs and record short clips — narration in English with localized subtitles for the three locales.
Samir: Also, do we need a short paragraph about data residency/regulatory implications per region? @legal-bot
legal-bot: For translations we require vendor NDA + data handling checklist. Looping in Contracts and SecOps; please avoid sending raw customer data to external vendors until cleared.
Maya: Action items: Maya -> final brief by Fri; Jeremy -> bench notes + code snippet; Olivia -> event page draft by Mon; Ben -> HubSpot workflows by next Wed; Alex_devrel -> draft video scripts by Tue. Ping me if you want to help with translations.
Jeremy: :party_parrot: Social plan — two eng-focused threads (Twitter/X/LinkedIn) + a longer case blog 4 weeks after launch.
Olivia: Scheduling note — micro AMA in community channel the week after the webinar.
Maya: :eyes: I'll update the checklist and add a QA pass for the localized code examples. Thanks team!
